# serverroom_monitor (Resource)

A monitor of your own: a website, a TCP port or a ping target, checked as often as the service's support tier allows. Alerts go to the channels set on the Alerts page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "serverroom_monitor" "shop" {
  account_id = 246447
  name       = "Shop homepage"
  type       = "http"
  target     = "https://shop.example.com/"
  keyword    = "Add to cart"
  interval   = 60
}

resource "serverroom_monitor" "postgres" {
  account_id = 246447
  name       = "Postgres"
  type       = "tcp"
  target     = "db.example.com"
  port       = 5432
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (Number) The service whose tier the monitor counts against.
- `name` (String)
- `target` (String) A URL for http, a host name or IP otherwise.
- `type` (String) http, tcp or ping.

### Optional

- `confirm` (Number) Failed checks in a row before an alert.
- `interval` (Number) Seconds between checks.
- `keyword` (String) A word the page must contain (http).
- `paused` (Boolean)
- `port` (Number) The port, for tcp.
- `timeout` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String) up, down, pending or paused.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import serverroom_monitor.shop mon_0123456789abcdef
```
